research_question: Which inter-alpha-trypsin inhibitor heavy chain genes form the 3p21.1 cluster implicated in psychiatric GWAS, and what are their gene models?

phase_1.user_prompt: Our bivariate GWAS of depression and bipolar disorder keeps returning the same signal at 3p21.1, and the strongest association sits over a cluster of inter-alpha-trypsin inhibitor heavy chain genes. Not every member of that gene family lives at this locus — some sit on a different chromosome entirely — and we only want the ones actually in the cluster. Give us the approved human gene symbols for the inter-alpha-trypsin inhibitor heavy chain genes located in the 3p21.1 cluster, and the Ensembl species name.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now pull the full gene model for each of those genes from Ensembl, expanded so we get every transcript, so we can look at where the coding variants fall.
